Name: Web Search Agents by Nimble
Tagline: Self-learning agents automate web research + retrieval
Description: Web Search Agents are expert web crawling and research agents for your specific domain (company enrichment, regulations research, etc.). They self-learn your use case to go deeper into the sources that matter most to you, giving your AI deeper and more relevant web context. To get started, give your AI this link: https://docs.nimbleway.com/agent-onboarding.md

Name: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2
Tagline: Turns website traffic into booked, qualified meetings
Description: Your book-a-demo button converts 1-2% of visitors. The rest leave. Naoma replaces the form with an AI account executive that runs the demo right then: it walks the prospect through your live product, answers questions, qualifies them and books the meeting. It remembers returning visitors, picks up where they left off, and writes every session back to your CRM. 50,000+ demos run for B2B SaaS teams. Now self-serve: upload your product and knowledge base test the agent today.

Name: Slashy Assistant
Tagline: The AI assistant that does email for you
Description: Slashy is an AI-native email client for managing all your inboxes. Slashy Assistant is the AI built into it: it drafts replies in your voice, organizes email, schedules meetings, prepares briefings, and tracks follow-ups. Connect your calendar, CRM, meeting notes, and favorite tools, and it starts helping within five minutes. Use it inside Slashy or through iMessage, Slack, or a phone call. Set up automations in plain English, and Slashy proactively handles recurring work before you have to ask.

Name: Hello Inbox
Tagline: Get more marketing emails into the inbox
Description: Hello Inbox helps marketing teams get more emails into the inbox instead of spam. Test your campaigns before you send, see what is hurting deliverability, and get clear recommendations for what to fix. Instead of throwing deliverability scores and technical data at you, Hello Inbox turns the results into actionable steps so you can improve inbox placement without becoming an email deliverability expert.

Name: Aside
Tagline: AI browser that actually gets work done for you
Description: Aside is a browser rebuilt for people and agents. It signs into your accounts, uses websites directly, and finishes complex work: messages, payments, internal tools, even local files. - Crafted in every detail: vertical tabs and Liquid Glass. - SOTA on agentic browsing benchmarks: outperforms Claude Cowork. - Full privacy: everything runs locally and is encrypted. - You can use your Claude or ChatGPT subscription.

Name: TryCase
Tagline: Open a PR and get a video walkthrough of your changes
Description: Open a PR. TryCase uses your app like a real user and sends back a video walkthrough of your changes, plus a test verdict, right on GitHub. See what happened before you merge, with multiple PRs tested in parallel.

Name: AppZapper 3000
Tagline: The uninstaller Apple forgot.
Description: The most fun uninstaller for macOS has been rebuilt for the 31st century. Introducing AppZapper 3000. Drag in any app and instantly find all of its extra files. Then delete them with a real 3D zapper.

Name: Elva
Tagline: Goodbye, Postman. Your APIs have new consumers
Description: Developers use your APIs. Now agents do too. Elva discovers APIs from code, lets you choose what each audience can use, and runs your MCP servers with auth and analytics. Track agent activity and review changes as your code evolves

Name: OzBrain
Tagline: Your knowledge shared with every AI agent & any teammate
Description: Your Dropbox for agent knowledge (it works without you having to "work" it or maintain it.) Every agent you use reads and writes to the same brain, and so do your teammates and theirs. Start a new chat and it can know what you've all already worked on. Your IP, research, sci-fi romance novel or notes are encrypted and I won't train on it. Export it to markdown and leave whenever, because I think you shouldn't have your knowledge locked in anywhere, including OzBrain.

Name: appdesigns
Tagline: Design amazing appstore screenshots for free
Description: appdesigns is a free, in-browser editor for App Store and Google Play screenshots. Drop in your screens, frame them in the latest iPhone, iPad or Mac, add headlines, backgrounds and stickers, and export at the exact sizes App Store Connect asks for. Design the whole set side by side, tilt and scale devices, or start from a community template. Unlimited exports, no watermark, and no account needed to start.

Name: Afterglow
Tagline: Run classic After Dark screen savers on modern macOS
Description: Afterglow runs classic After Dark screen saver modules — Flying Toasters, Fish!, Starry Skyline, and more — natively on macOS, with no ROMs required.

Name: Deplo
Tagline: A ridiculously good alternative to the cloud.
Description: Same push-to-deploy you already know, running on a machine you already pay for. No Docker. No SSH. No invoice.

Name: LLMagnet
Tagline: Make your WordPress site visible to AI
Description: LLMagnet gives WordPress sites an AI visibility layer. Track visits from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI crawlers, measure your AI Visibility Score, generate llms.txt and structured data, and make your site readable and actionable for AI agents.

Name: OVO
Tagline: Play music from files, iCloud & streams across Apple devices
Description: OVO is a premium music player for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Bring local files, Apple Music, supported SoundCloud content, live streams, and synced folders into one focused library. Listen offline, shape playback with a 10-band EQ, and privately sync your library between iPhone and iPad through iCloud.

Name: Marqly 6.0
Tagline: Ask your bookmarks. Bring them to your AI.
Description: Your bookmarks have more to give. Marqly 6.0 adds an AI Assistant that answers from your saves, an AI Organizer that proposes a cleaner library for you to review, and MCP to bring your saved research into Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor. Keep articles, highlights, videos, and AI chats together. Available on the web, in your browser, and on iOS. Android is coming very soon. AI features are included in Pro.

Name: MemoryPet 2.0
Tagline: Turn your browsers toolbar into an animated usage monitor
Topics: Browser Extensions, Chrome Extensions, Productivity, User Experience
Description: MemoryPet puts a tiny animated pet in your Chrome toolbar that speeds up or slows down based on your system's memory or CPU usage, a glanceable, oddly satisfying read on how hard your machine is working. 2.0 adds CPU tracking alongside memory, 8 new pets, a hover-able usage graph, and a way to turn the animation off entirely and just watch a live percentage badge instead.

Name: Image to ASCII
Tagline: Make ASCII art for READMEs, Discord & creative visuals
Description: Give your README a signature, your Discord a mascot, or your next blog post a character-art cover. Turn photos and logos into ASCII locally in your browser—free, with no signup or image upload. Start with a built-in example, compare before/after, and tune presets, detail and color. Copy text or Markdown; export TXT, PNG, SVG, HTML or ANSI. Text formats keep editable characters; image exports preserve the look. Try the neon jellyfish or make an 80-column fox README mark.

Name: Oats
Tagline: Free, open-source, and on device meeting notetaker
Topics: Open Source, Meetings, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Oats is an AI meeting note-taking tool that is completely open, local, and free. Designed to not get in the way of your meetings, no bots, no subscription needed when running locally with on-device LLM. Available on both macOS and Windows. Enhanced transcription, multi-language support, speaker recognition, assessment, coaching, auto-tracking follow ups and more features via ariso.ai cloud backend.

Name: Juggler
Tagline: A visual AI coding harness
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Juggler is a desktop workbench for AI coding agents. Tool calls, approvals, thread structure and raw context are laid out in Finder-style columns. Conversations branch into sub-threads. Every tool is a JavaScript plugin. Free, open-source, one Go binary.

Name: Bluey Email
Tagline: Marketing email, transactional email and CRM, one bill
Description: Bluey bills for emails sent, not contacts stored, so your bill doesn't step up the day you cross 25K contacts. Marketing campaigns, transactional sends like receipts and OTPs, and a CRM with a deal pipeline live in one account on one bill instead of three vendors. Composer writes a whole campaign from one sentence. Grow plan is $30/mo for 50K sends with unlimited contacts.
